title: Can You Eat Your Favorite Candy On Your Favorite Day
statement:
You have `candiesCount[i]` candies of type `i`. You eat at least one candy per day, starting on day 0, and eat the candy types in order: type `i` can be eaten only after all candies of type `i - 1` have been eaten. You may eat multiple types in one day, and you may eat at most `dailyCap` candies that day.

For each query `[favoriteType, favoriteDay, dailyCap]`, return whether it is possible to eat a candy of `favoriteType` on `favoriteDay`. Return one boolean for each query in the same order.

## Examples

```text
Input: candiesCount = [7, 4, 5, 3, 8], queries = [[0, 2, 2], [4, 2, 4], [2, 13, 1000000000]]
Output: [true, false, true]
```

```text
Input: candiesCount = [5, 2, 6, 4, 1], queries = [[3, 1, 2], [4, 10, 3], [3, 10, 100], [4, 100, 30], [1, 3, 1]]
Output: [false, true, true, false, false]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= candiesCount.length, queries.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= candiesCount[i] <= 10^5`
- Each query has three integers `[favoriteType, favoriteDay, dailyCap]`.
- `0 <= favoriteType < candiesCount.length`
- `0 <= favoriteDay <= 10^9`
- `1 <= dailyCap <= 10^9`
